notes.title: Game released + First Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
I'm excited to share that I launched my first two games on Steam just two days ago! 🎉
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193923/c85453e808fe0f039c768d27db61a19203ea1d56.gif
Here's a quick rundown of the latest update:
 Game Progress Save: Your game progress is now saved automatically.
 Settings Save: All settings changes will now be saved.
 Achievements Fix: Achievements now unlock individually as you find each dog, rather than all at once.
 Reset Progress Option: Added a button in the options menu to reset your game progress and achievements.

If you encounter any issues, please let me know. Thank you for your support and happy gaming!

Please check out my other game here on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3242890/101_Cute_Playland_Dogs_Find__Paint/

And the bundle with everything released
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46509/101_Cute_Dogs__Master_Bundle/
